messages:
incident-bot: Paging: Latency SLO breach detected for /v1/stream endpoint (p95 -> 420ms, p99 -> 1.6s). Auto-escalation threshold met. Notifying on-call and eng-sre.

sara_infra: ack — oncall-rota you're up. seeing spike correlated with backend GPU pool. stacktrace-ish: lots of streaming stalls reported from KV-cache layer.

oncall-rota: I'm on it. pulling metrics now. which customers are hitting this? @tara_prod can you surface customer impact?

tara_prod: Customer impact: 3 tenants with persistent sessions (alpha-shop, docs-ai, play-demo). Approx 5.8% of total requests, but many are long-lived streaming => tail impact higher. Support already has 2 tickets opened. ETA notify customers within 15m.

mike_sre: digging into infra metrics — node group gpu-pool-a shows increased ECC correctable errors on gpunode-12 and gpunode-15, thermal up on gpunode-12 (85C sustained). GPU perf counters show repeated memory re-reads.

eng_ravi: that looks like ECC churn causing kernel retries. can we confirm driver logs? ask ops_jen for nvml / dmesg.

ops_jen: pulling logs from gpunode-12 now. snippet:

```
Mar 14 10:41:02 gpunode-12 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 31, pid=0b3a, ... ECC correctable error count: +1
Mar 14 10:41:12 gpunode-12 kernel: thermal: GPU temp rising above threshold: 85 -> throttling
Mar 14 10:41:27 gpunode-12 runtime: stall detected: kv cache miss flood, stream stitch timeout
```

ops_jen: also seeing transient PCI link resets around same window on gpunode-15 but less thermal.

sara_infra: timeline: p95 jump started ~10:40 UTC, p99 spike at 10:42. root cause candidate: intermittent ECC/thermal causing micro stalls in the accelerator path and leading to upstream streaming tail latencies.

mike_sre: short mitigation plan: 1) cordon + drain heavy streaming pods off gpunode-12, 2) failover new streams to dedicated fallback pool (gpu-pool-b), 3) mark gpunode-12 for hardware quarantine and open HW ticket. Who can run drains? eng_ravi?

eng_ravi: running drain now on gpunode-12. command:

```
kubectl cordon gpunode-12 && kubectl drain gpunode-12 --ignore-daemonsets --timeout=300s
```

eng_ravi: starting traffic shift: rerouting live routes for /v1/stream -> fallback models in pool-b for sessions created after now. existing sessions will be proxied but we're throttling new acceptances.

oncall-rota: updating runbook status: marking incident as SEV2 (latency SLO breach, partial customer impact). Noting fallback activated and HW ticket created. Please post short customer-facing blurb when we have ETA on remediation.

tara_prod: customer blurb draft: "We're investigating intermittent latency spikes affecting streaming endpoints. We're shifting workloads to alternate capacity and expect reduced impact in the next 15-30 minutes. We'll follow up with a full post-incident summary." lgtm?

mike_sre: quick check — after draining gpunode-12 p95 dropped to ~130ms, p99 down to ~420ms, streaming stall count reduced but not zero. Looks like gpunode-15 still has sporadic ECCs causing residual tail.

ops_jen: running hardware diagnostics on gpunode-12: remote sensor logs show fan speed was at 72% and thermal trip events aligning with stalls. raising HW ticket:  RHW-8421. tagging vendor.

eng_ravi: to reduce risk while HW replaced, propose auto-evacuate policy for nodes with >5 corr ECC in 10m window. we can flip policy to be more aggressive temporarily.

sara_infra: good idea. mike, can you enable aggressive quarantine flag for the pool for 30m? we'll monitor.

mike_sre: enabled quarantine-aggressive=true for gpu-pool-a. policy: immediate cold-evacuate on 4+ corr ECC in 5m. alert thresholds adjusted.

oncall-rota: customer impact update: short bursts still seen for a small subset of long-lived sessions, but majority of traffic is back to normal. support update: two customers asked for a status update; sent tara's blurb.

tara_prod: support confirmed both alpha-shop and play-demo saw reduced error rates after traffic shift. docs-ai still reported intermittent rebuffering — investigating session affinity.

eng_ravi: found a sticky affinity rule keeping some sessions pinned to gpunode-15. rolling patch: remove strict affinity for streaming pods, apply session-proxy to reconnect clients to new instances.

ops_jen: after re-proxying sessions away from gpunode-15, p99 at 11:05 is 310ms and stall metrics back to baseline. HW vendor confirmed replacement GPU on order.

oncall-rota: moving this to monitoring mode. we'll keep gpunode-12 quarantined and gpunode-15 under watch. incident timeline + actions to be added to postmortem. tagging for follow-up: @eng-ml for model sensitivity analysis to ECC-induced stalls.

sara_infra: thanks everyone. quick actions summarized:
- drained/cordoned gpunode-12
- traffic shifted to gpu-pool-b fallback
- quarantine-aggressive toggled
- HW ticket RHW-8421 opened
- session affinity fix rolled
- monitoring confirms recovery

mike_sre: closing the page but leaving thread open for postmortem notes. please drop any logs or timelines here.

incident-bot: Incident SEV2 (4319991234) moved to resolved state for active paging. Postmortem reminder in 24h. :white_check_mark:
